name: Polished Fist
description: Punch with a fist faced in polished crystal that gleams and lands with a clean flat knock.

name: Polished Plate
description: Raise a polished plate before the chest whose smooth face gives a blow nothing to catch.

name: Polished Stride
description: Glide over a polished crystal sheen laid under the feet in one smooth stride.

name: Polished Edge
description: Slash with a polished edge so the strike lands and the opponent's guard is cut wide.

name: Polished Ward
description: Hold a polished ward that sheds blows and keeps a bright and even face against them.

name: Polished Lens
description: Look through a polished lens of crystal and see the crack in an opponent's guard.

name: Polished Blow
description: Drive a polished block of crystal into the guard with the weight of the whole body behind it.

name: Polished Mantle
description: Spread a polished mantle over the user and the nearest ally and steady the pair under it.

name: Polished Radiance
description: Flood the field with bright light thrown off a hundred polished faces so the foes are cut and dazzled.

name: Faceted Mind
description: The school's closing stand: each facet of the mind turns a different part of a blow back with strength scaling to its force.

name: Nodal Fist
description: Punch from a node of the lattice so the force travels as one stiff column into the target.

name: Nodal Plate
description: Raise a plate on four nodes of the lattice so a blow is spread evenly over them.

name: Nodal Stride
description: Stride from node to node of the lattice in equal long steps.

name: Nodal Press
description: Press down through the nodes of the lattice on the opponent until their qi lies flat.

name: Nodal Guard
description: Hold the nearest nodes in a tight guard that bears the blows by sharing them out.

name: Nodal Spur
description: Set an ally on a node of the lattice so their qi is steadied by the user's.

name: Nodal Cleansing
description: Run a clear line of lattice through an ally and filter the poison from the blood.

name: Nodal Collapse
description: Pull the nodes inward so the lattice collapses on every foe inside its frame.

name: Nodal Lance
description: Drive one lattice column forward as a lance that passes through guard and body together.

name: Standing Nexus
description: Raise a great nexus of lattice that locks every foe near it in place and cuts them where they stand.

name: Perfect Lattice
description: The school's defining move: a perfect lattice stands over the field to press down the foes and shelter the user with scaling strength.

name: Thousandfold Fist
description: Punch with a fist covered in countless tiny facets that shatter the force into a bright spray on impact.

name: Thousandfold Plate
description: Raise a plate cut with a thousand fine facets that scatter a blow's force in all directions.

name: Thousandfold Stride
description: Stride through a glitter of fine facets and arrive from a direction the eye did not follow.

name: Thousandfold Dart
description: Loose a fine spray of tiny crystal darts that each prick a different point on the target.

name: Thousandfold Ward
description: Hang a many-faceted ward before the user that cuts every force into small and harmless parts.

name: Thousandfold Return
description: Catch a blow on the many faces and send a share of it back from each at the thrower.

name: Thousandfold Glare
description: Flash a thousand bright points into the foe's eyes until they cannot find the user among them.

name: Thousandfold Purge
description: Pass an ally's blood through a thousand fine facets that strain out poison and taint.

name: Thousandfold Storm
description: Loose a storm of fine crystal over the whole group of foes so that each is cut by a thousand points.

name: Thousandfold Lance
description: Gather the thousand facets into one white lance that drives through armour and body.

name: Faceted Crown
description: Raise a crown of countless facets round the user that shields them and cuts every foe close.

name: Thousand Facets
description: The school's crowning move in which each facet fires a piercing beam at a different foe with strength scaling to the reserve.

name: Glassy Fist
description: Punch with a fist wrapped in clear and brittle glassy crystal that breaks into cutting pieces on impact.

name: Glassy Plate
description: Raise a plate of clear glassy crystal that turns a blow and sheds its pieces into the air.

name: Glassy Step
description: Slide forward on a glassy film laid on the wind with a faint ring underfoot.

name: Glassy Slash
description: Slash with a glassy edge on the wind so the strike lands and the opponent's guard flies wide.

name: Glassy Screen
description: Hold a screen of glassy shards on the wind that turns each blow off to the side.

name: Glassy Clearing
description: Blow glassy grit across an ally's wound to scour out the fouling and leave the edges clean.

name: Glassy Rain
description: Call down a rain of glassy shards on the wind over the whole group of foes.

name: Glassy Mending
description: Grow clear glassy crystal into deep wounds on several allies to close them and carry off the pain.

name: Glass Unbroken
description: Raise a great pane of glass-clear crystal that no blow can mar and that bursts outward on the foe.

name: Cutting Glass
description: The school's closing move in which a great fall of glass cuts every foe and pierces the nearest with strength scaling to the reserve.

name: Brilliant Fist
description: Punch with a fist so bright with crystal light that the foe flinches as it lands.

name: Brilliant Plate
description: Raise a bright plate whose glare spoils the aim of those who strike at it.

name: Brilliant Step
description: Step along a line of brilliant light cut in the air and arrive at the end of it.

name: Brilliant Eye
description: Let the bright crystal catch each small movement of a stranger and read it in the glint.

name: Brilliant Cut
description: Cut with a bright edge so the strike lands and the opponent's eyes lose the weapon for an instant.

name: Brilliant Ward
description: Hold a ward of dazzling crystal that no blow finds clearly enough to land square.

name: Brilliant Lend
description: Share a clear bright focus with an ally so their aim and their edge both sharpen.

name: Brilliant Clearing
description: Pass a bright clear light through an ally and burn off the cloud of a curse upon them.

name: Brilliant Crash
description: Bring a bright block of crystal onto the target in one swift blow that splits the guard.

name: Brilliant Bloom
description: Open a bloom of bright crystal edges round the user that cuts and dazzles all near.

name: Brilliance Unbound
description: Loose every held ray in a single burst that pierces the foe and leaves their sight in ruin.

name: Edge Brilliant
description: The school's defining cut in which a single bright edge parts any guard before the eye follows it with keenness scaling to the reserve.

name: Hollowed Fist
description: Punch with a fist of crystal grown round an empty space that rings and cracks open on the target.

name: Hollowed Plate
description: Raise a hollow plate of crystal whose inner space soaks up the shock of a blow.

name: Hollowed Stride
description: Stride on hollow crystal stones that give a light ringing spring at each step.

name: Hollowed Burst
description: Break the hollow shell so the crystals inside fly outward and cut all who stand near.

name: Hollowed Hold
description: Hold the shell closed round the user while the crystal inside keeps it from caving in.

name: Hollowed Salve
description: Open the hollow over an ally's wound and let clear soft crystal grow inward to close it.

name: Hollowed Purge
description: Draw the taint of a curse or poison into the hollow and seal it away in the crystal.

name: Hollowed Crash
description: Drop the whole hollow shell on the target so that it shatters with great weight on the guard.

name: Hollowed Rally
description: Grow a shared hollow shell round the nearby allies and steady each of them inside it.

name: Geode Crowned
description: Close a vast geode over the user and open it in a crown of crystal that cuts all foes near.

name: Heartstone Bloom
description: The school's deepest move in which the geode blooms outward to cut the foes and mend the allies with strength scaling to the reserve.
